t: You're standing in front of the statue of George Orwell, outside Broadcasting House, the headquarters of the BBC. The sculptor Martin Jennings made it, and it was unveiled on 7 November 2017. Orwell was the pen name of Eric Arthur Blair, a novelist, essayist and journalist. His work is known for its clear prose, its social criticism, and its opposition to all totalitarianism. Jennings works in bronze and stone, and has also made statues of John Betjeman at St Pancras and Mary Seacole at St Thomas' Hospital.
